project_name: Responsible Charity Society - AimGame 15-Year Scholarship Program

image_urls.description: Indian children participating in a creative art and painting workshop on the floor, focused, joyful, and dignified.

headings.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-tight

rules.contrast: Ensure text contrast ratio meets APCA/WCAG AA guidelines (min 4.5:1 for standard text).
rules.tinted_grey: Always tint greys with warm sand or cool blue tones instead of flat neutral grey.

layouts.editorial_grid: Asymmetric multi-column Swiss/editorial layout with generous padding (p-8 to p-16).
layouts.education_grid: High-impact visual story grid showcasing dignified Indian scholarship recipients, creative arts workshops, and long-term educational outcomes.

motion.micro_interactions: Subtle scale shifts (scale-105 on card hover) and smooth fade-ins.

accessibility.test_ids: All key interactive and content elements MUST include data-testid attributes.
accessibility.alt_text: All images must feature respectful, descriptive alt text for screen readers.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.component_reuse: Prioritize pre-existing UI primitives in src/components/ui/.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing: Ensure data-testid attributes are present on all key interactive elements.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.photography: Always use dignified, authentic photography in Indian contexts.
